metadata.session: 2026-05-25 six-agent brainstorm fanout (A1-A6 + cross-review + primary pass)

agents.long_mandate: Brainstorm debug, observability, and CloudWatch tooling that exploits full AWS admin + direct kubectl + ArgoCD/Keycloak API + unlimited egress to answer "what is happening with X" in seconds across phases 0–6.

ideas.idea: `scripts/whereami.sh` one-shot that prints account ID, region, EKS name, zone, kubectl ctx, ArgoCD URL, Crossplane version.
ideas.justification: First thing every session needs; replaces five separate `aws`/`kubectl` invocations.

comments.idea: Turn `scripts/whereami.sh` (A1-001) into a JSON-emitting mode so e2e tests can assert account/region/cluster fixtures match `terraform.tfvars` before running.
comments.justification: Reusing a debug script as a precondition gate prevents tests from running against the wrong sandbox.

comments.idea: Run A1-001 `whereami.sh` once at session start AND export its outputs to `/tmp/session.env` so every subagent sources it instead of re-probing.
comments.justification: Avoids N subagents hammering STS/EKS describe at session start.

comments.idea: Once `scripts/whereami.sh` (A1-001) lands, retire the per-script preambles that re-echo account/region/cluster in every diag tool.
comments.justification: Single source; preamble noise vanishes.

ideas.idea: `scripts/phase-status.sh` that walks phases 0–6 and prints state (`not-coded` / `code-only` / `applied` / `verified`) by probing live resources, not the handoff.
ideas.justification: Handoff state drifts; live probe is ground truth (per AGENTS.md §8.1).

comments.idea: Promote `phase-status.sh` (A1-002) to a chainsaw `assert:` oracle that verifies each phase's `verified` state inside a smoke test.
comments.justification: Live-probe truth becomes an automated regression guard, not just a human aid.

comments.idea: Extend A1-002 `phase-status.sh` to also emit a JSON manifest a regression test can diff against the previous run, turning live probes into a drift oracle.
comments.justification: Doubles the debug tool as a recurring test artifact; would have surfaced Bug 3 (Kyverno drift) on cadence.

comments.idea: Phase-status probe (A1-002) can fan out per-phase with `make -j7 probe-phase-{0..6}`; each probe is independent.
comments.justification: Critical path becomes max-probe-time not sum.

comments.idea: When `scripts/phase-status.sh` (A1-002) is the oracle, delete the Environment State table in `ai/handoff.md` in favor of a generated include.
comments.justification: Removes the drift class A1-002 was built to eliminate.

ideas.idea: Enable EKS control-plane logging (api, audit, authenticator, controllerManager, scheduler) on cluster creation in `terraform/management/eks.tf`.
ideas.justification: Authenticator/audit logs are the only way to debug IRSA & RBAC denials post-hoc.

comments.idea: Add an integration test that, after enabling EKS control-plane logging (A1-003), writes a synthetic `system:anonymous` request and asserts the audit log group receives the line within 60s.
comments.justification: Proves the logging pipeline actually emits, not just that the cluster claims it's enabled.

comments.idea: Have EKS control-plane logging include a `scripts/eks-logs-tail.sh` thin wrapper that pre-selects the audit log group + last 5 min — surfaces what A1-003 enables.
comments.justification: Enabling logs without a paired reader leaves them undiscovered.

comments.idea: Stream EKS control-plane logs (A1-003) live into the conductor's event bus (A5-027) so audit denials trigger downstream subagents instantly.
comments.justification: Turns CloudWatch logs into push not pull.

comments.idea: EKS control-plane logging (A1-003) lets us delete every workflow-side "kubectl get events
comments.justification: refactor | Audit log is durable; pod-side scraping was a hack.

ideas.idea: Enable VPC flow logs to CloudWatch in `terraform/base/vpc.tf` with a 7-day retention.
ideas.justification: NAT/SG/route bugs are invisible without flow logs; cheap insurance.

ideas.idea: CloudTrail trail to a dedicated CloudWatch log group with 7-day retention.
ideas.justification: Post-mortem any IAM/API failure with a single Logs Insights query.

comments.justification: Evidence-quoting cannot be skipped if the tool emits the quote ready-to-paste.

comments.idea: A1-018 `irsa_trust_validator.py` fans out trivially: run it for every role concurrently (one subprocess per role).

ideas.idea: `scripts/crossplane-trace.sh <claim>` that walks claim → XR → resourceRefs → MRs → underlying AWS object, printing `.status.conditions` at each layer.
ideas.justification: One command answers "where is the chain broken".

comments.idea: Wrap `crossplane-trace.sh` (A1-019) output as a chainsaw `error:` block — when an assert fails, the trace dumps automatically.
comments.justification: Failure evidence is structured at no extra cost.

comments.idea: Add a "snapshot mode" to A1-019 `crossplane-trace.sh` that writes condition snapshots to disk so two consecutive runs can diff XR/MR state over time.
comments.justification: Catches "XR went silent" between reconciles; would have flagged the v2.0.1 zero-conditions bug.

comments.idea: A1-019 `crossplane-trace.sh` should write to the event bus on each layer-flip so a watcher subagent can react to "MR appeared" without polling.
comments.justification: Composes with A5-027/A5-030.

comments.idea: `scripts/crossplane-trace.sh` (A1-019) lets us delete `phase-2-diagnose.yml` entirely — the dispatch workflow exists only because no local trace did.
comments.justification: Removes a 250-line workflow yaml.

ideas.idea: `scripts/argocd-app-poll.sh <app>` that hits ArgoCD API and waits until `Synced/Healthy` with a deadline.
ideas.justification: Replaces hand-rolled retry loops in integration scripts.

ideas.idea: `scripts/wait-for-claim.sh <kind> <name> [ns] [timeout]` that watches conditions and dumps composition events on timeout.
ideas.justification: Standardizes the most-repeated pattern in tests/integration.

comments.idea: Use `wait-for-claim.sh` (A1-021) as the canonical wait primitive in every A2 soak/concurrency test (A2-016, A2-017, A2-050).

comments.idea: `scripts/wait-for-claim.sh` (A1-021) replaces every bespoke `until kubectl get ...; do sleep` loop in tests/integration/*.sh.

ideas.idea: Auto-create a CloudWatch log group per ArgoCD app sync round via a controller, retention 7d.
ideas.justification: Long-lived audit trail of GitOps actions; correlate with cluster events.

ideas.idea: `scripts/nlb-trace.sh` that walks Ingress → Service → NLB ARN → target group health → SG rules → reach test from a debug pod.
ideas.justification: Six-hop debug collapsed into one command.

general_comments.idea: A single `inspect <resource>` shell wrapper that auto-dispatches (claim → XR → MR → IRSA → cloud) based on `kind` so the agent types one verb regardless of what's broken.

general_comments.idea: Auto-create a CloudWatch Logs log group `/k8-platform/agent-session/$DATE` and tee every `aws`/`kubectl` invocation into it for postmortem replay.

general_comments.idea: A `dashboards/` folder of one JSON per dashboard (EKS, Crossplane, ESO, ArgoCD, ExternalDNS, Kyverno, Cognito) that Terraform applies idempotently on every phase-1 apply.

general_comments.idea: A "diagnose digest" Python script that pulls the last hour from all relevant log groups + last 50 events from all crossplane-system pods + all MR statuses into a single ~5 KB digest the agent can paste back into context.

agents.long_mandate: Brainstorm integration / E2E / chaos / soak / negative / concurrency / contract tests that become trivial now that the agent has full AWS admin, direct kubectl, ArgoCD/Keycloak admin APIs, unlimited egress, and CloudWatch SDK access.

ideas.idea: End-to-end PlatformSecret claim round-trip that creates the claim, waits Ready, then uses the AWS Secrets Manager SDK to read the resulting ASM secret and assert tags/KMS/replication match the Composition.
ideas.justification: The composition can render a "Ready" MR while the actual ASM Secret has wrong tags/region/KMS — only an SDK readback proves the cloud truth.

comments.idea: Pair every claim-roundtrip (A2-001/044) with an automatic CloudTrail cross-check that asserts the exact AWS principal + IRSA role chain that performed the write, captured by event-name.
comments.justification: Proves *who* did the write, not just that the write happened — catches privilege drift.

comments.idea: A2-018 soak test can run in background while A2-001 round-trip and A2-007 drift tests run in foreground — three independent tests, one wall-clock.
comments.justification: Soak is wall-clock-bound, not CPU; overlap freely.

comments.idea: A2-053 ASM rotation test can be triggered by event bus the instant A2-001 round-trip subagent reports Ready, no sleep.
comments.justification: Removes explicit wait.

comments.idea: A2-001/002/044/045 claim-roundtrip tests share scaffolding — extract a "claim-rt-harness" subagent that all four call, instead of duplicating setup.
comments.justification: DRY at the orchestration layer.

comments.idea: Once A2-001's SDK readback works, retire any chainsaw `assert` block that only checks `.status.conditions[*].Ready` on the XR — the SDK is a stronger oracle.
comments.justification: Stronger gate replaces weaker one.

comments.idea: Full E2E claim->ASM byte-compare (A2-034) makes the layered tests A2-001 + A2-012 + A2-053 partially redundant — once the byte-compare passes, those become smoke-only.
comments.justification: Single end-to-end oracle subsumes mid-chain probes.

ideas.idea: Same PlatformSecret round-trip but probe the cloud truth from a DIFFERENT region's STS+SecretsManager client to catch global vs regional endpoint bugs.
ideas.justification: Region-specific Composition bugs (wrong provider region override) silently pass single-region tests.

ideas.idea: IRSA correctness test that, for every IRSA role in `terraform/management/irsa.tf`, calls `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` with the exact actions the SA's pods need and asserts allowed.
ideas.justification: Permissions drift is invisible until a claim fails in production — simulate-principal catches it pre-flight.

comments.idea: Extend A2-003 (simulate-principal) to also dump the resolved effective policy JSON per role into an artifact so future debugging has a baseline diff.

comments.idea: A2-003 IRSA simulate-principal-policy fans out: one async call per role, gather with asyncio.

comments.idea: IRSA simulate-principal-policy test (A2-003) supersedes the inline `aws iam get-role-policy` greps in `test_irsa_policy_completeness.sh`.
comments.justification: API-level oracle replaces text-grep heuristics.

ideas.idea: IRSA live-token test that runs `aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity` using a freshly projected SA token from each platform SA, confirming trust+permissions at the token level.
ideas.justification: The cluster<->IAM federation can break in five places; only a live AssumeRole proves the chain works.

comments.idea: A2-004 (live AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity) makes every "does this IRSA work" smoke test pod (deployed just to call STS) deletable.

ideas.idea: Cross-resource invariant test: every IRSA role's trust `sub` must match a SA actually present in the live cluster (catches stale role drift).

comments.idea: Add a Bug-5 regression scenario to A2-005 (trust=SA invariant): rename a platform SA in a fixture and assert the invariant test fails loudly.

comments.idea: A2-005 + A2-006 bidirectional IRSA invariants collapse `test_irsa_trust_subject.sh` and `test_irsa_sa_annotation.sh` into one parameterized test.

comments.idea: Pair A2-007 (ArgoCD drift diff) with a Kyverno PolicyReport snapshot so drift attributable to admission mutation is auto-classified vs human edits.

comments.idea: ArgoCD admin-API drift test (A2-007) retires manual "argocd app diff" runbooks in `ai/runbooks/` (or wherever the historical equivalents live).

ideas.idea: ArgoCD admin-API forced-sync test that triggers `POST /api/v1/applications/<name>/sync` for every app and asserts `Synced/Healthy` within deadline.

ideas.justification: Removes the "apply → wait-for-ready → next apply" anti-pattern.

comments.idea: Extend A5-018 (background kubectl-wait) with structured exit-status persistence to `/tmp/wait-results.json` so the conductor can join on multiple waits.
comments.justification: Conductor-pattern needs a join primitive.

comments.idea: A5-018 (background `kubectl wait`) lets us remove the explicit "wait for X" steps from sequential apply scripts; verification overlaps for free.
comments.justification: Removes serial-wait pattern.

ideas.idea: Pre-create the ACM cert (long DNS-validation tail) at session start so it's ISSUED by the time anything actually needs it.
ideas.justification: ACM validation is the longest single wait in phase-0; starting it first overlaps with everything.

comments.idea: Pair A5-019 (pre-create ACM cert) with a verification that the cert's DNS validation record is in Route53 BEFORE waiting on ISSUED — speeds up failure detection.
comments.justification: Validation hang is silent; pre-checking the CNAME is the fast oracle.

ideas.idea: Stand up Crossplane providers via `kubectl apply` directly (not helm) while helm is still installing argo-cd, since they share no controllers.
ideas.justification: Breaks the current helm-then-helm-then-crossplane chain in `terraform/management/helm.tf`.

ideas.idea: Use a "chained wait-then-trigger" CLI (e.g. `until kubectl get ... ; do sleep 2; done && next-cmd`) launched in background per phase boundary.
ideas.justification: Replaces manual checking with event hooks the agent can subscribe to via Monitor.

ideas.idea: Treat `terraform/base` outputs as a static manifest, regenerate once, and serve to phase 1 via a local file instead of `terraform_remote_state` reading from S3 every plan.
ideas.justification: Removes the S3 GET round-trip on every phase-1 plan/apply.

comments.idea: A5-022 (cache base outputs locally) lets us remove the `terraform_remote_state` data source from phase-1 modules, simplifying graph + reducing S3 chatter.
comments.justification: Local file > remote_state for static outputs.

ideas.idea: Build a "phase compiler" that takes a YAML high-level plan ("bring up mgmt with secrets+keycloak") and emits parallel terraform + kubectl + argocd commands.
ideas.justification: Codifies the bring-up sequence so any agent (or human) can replay it deterministically.

comments.idea: A5-016 (Terragrunt run-all) supersedes A5-001, A5-002, A5-003, A5-009, A5-015, and A5-023 — adopting it lets us delete all the bespoke orchestration scaffolding.
comments.justification: One tool replaces six homegrown ideas.

ideas.idea: Cache `terraform init`'s `.terraform/providers/` in a shared volume across roots so each root doesn't re-download hashicorp/aws 600 MB.
ideas.justification: First `init` per root costs ~30 s today; shared cache makes subsequent inits ~2 s.

comments.idea: A5-024 shared provider cache should have a contract test that the cache directory's provider versions match what each root's `versions.tf` declares — silent-mismatch guard.
comments.justification: Shared caches introduce cross-root version-coupling bugs.

comments.idea: A5-024 (shared `.terraform/providers/` cache) lets us remove per-root `terraform init` from the documented bring-up steps — first session sets up, subsequents inherit.
comments.justification: Cache hides the step.

ideas.idea: Run `terraform validate && tflint` in parallel across all roots at session start as a pre-flight before any apply.
ideas.justification: Catches syntactic errors in zero AWS wall-clock instead of mid-apply.

ideas.idea: Pre-render every Helm chart with `helm template` against `--api-versions` and run `kyverno test` locally in parallel with the real cluster apply.
ideas.justification: Catches policy violations before they cause Sync failure on the real cluster.

ideas.idea: Maintain a Redis/SQLite "event bus" in `/tmp` that subagents post phase-completion events to, so listeners trigger downstream work without polling.
ideas.justification: Eliminates polling overhead and lets dozens of downstream tasks subscribe to one event.

comments.idea: Pair A5-027 (event bus) with an OpenTelemetry collector so each event is a span, queryable in Jaeger/Tempo.
comments.justification: Free distributed tracing of the orchestration graph itself.

comments.idea: Use A5-027 (Redis/SQLite event bus) as the substrate for the A2 e2e suite's test-orchestrator coordinating chaos+claim+verification subagents.
comments.justification: Same event bus drives ops and tests.

comments.idea: Extend A5-027 (event bus) with a "deadletter" log: events with no subscriber within deadline trigger an alarm — invisible orchestration bugs become visible.
comments.justification: Missed-event class is the hardest event-driven bug to debug.

comments.idea: A5-027's event bus retires every polling loop in scripts/ — they become subscribers.
comments.justification: Push > poll.

comments.idea: A5-007 (event-driven cluster-ready watcher) plus A5-027 (event bus) lets us delete every `sleep 600` style fixed wait remaining in phase scripts.
comments.justification: All waits become event subscriptions.

ideas.idea: Use `tmux` panes (or a TUI) so the human can watch base-apply, mgmt-apply, helm-install, and argo-sync logs side by side instead of reading one giant log.
ideas.justification: Improves human verification latency from "scroll a 170 KB log" to "glance at pane 3".

ideas.idea: Push ArgoCD `Application` manifests into the cluster *before* the workloads exist, so they go OutOfSync→Synced automatically the moment CRDs land.
ideas.justification: Removes the explicit "now apply this Application" hand-off step from each phase.

comments.idea: Add a smoke test that A5-029 (pre-staged ArgoCD apps) transitions OutOfSync→Synced within deadline once CRDs land — assert via ArgoCD admin API.
comments.justification: Speculative-apply pattern only works if the eventual sync actually happens.

comments.idea: A5-029 (pre-applied Applications) needs a regression test that an Application sitting in OutOfSync for >N minutes (because CRD never landed) becomes a hard failure, not silent waiting.
comments.justification: Pre-applied Apps can sit forever; need a deadline.

comments.idea: A5-029 (apply Applications pre-CRD) lets us delete the explicit sync-wave annotations on a chunk of `argocd/apps/*.yaml` — natural ordering handles it.
comments.justification: Eventual-consistency obviates wave hints.

ideas.idea: Use `crossplane beta trace` or a custom controller-runtime watcher to stream XR/MR condition changes live to the agent's stdout.
ideas.justification: Replaces `phase-2-diagnose.yml`'s batch snapshot with continuous evidence.

comments.idea: Extend A5-030 (live XR/MR condition stream) with a TUI dashboard (e.g. `k9s` plugin or bespoke) that highlights condition flips with timestamps.
comments.justification: Human pattern-recognition kicks in when state changes are visualized.

comments.idea: Build a chaos companion to A5-030 (live XR/MR streamer) that kills the streamer mid-stream and asserts the agent's downstream consumer reconnects cleanly.
comments.justification: Long-lived streams break; reconnect must be tested.

ideas.idea: Have one subagent run end-to-end teardown of a previous test namespace while another brings up the next test claim — no serial cleanup tax.
ideas.justification: Cleanup currently blocks the next iteration for ~30 s per claim.

ideas.idea: Cache `aws-iam-authenticator` / `aws eks get-token` tokens for kubectl across subagents via `KUBECONFIG=/tmp/shared-kubeconfig`.
ideas.justification: Avoids each agent re-hitting STS and burning the 6/s rate limit.

ideas.idea: Drive a "speculative phase-3" apply against a scratch namespace while phase-2 is still settling, then promote if upstream succeeds.
ideas.justification: Hides phase-3 wall-clock under phase-2's tail.

ideas.idea: Use `argocd app sync --async` for every Application in one shot, then `argocd app wait` in parallel, instead of one-at-a-time sync.
ideas.justification: Trivially cuts N-app reconcile time from sum-of-N to max-of-N.

comments.idea: Pair A5-034 (`argocd app sync --async` fan-out) with a concurrency test that asserts no app is stuck in `Progressing` past deadline.
comments.justification: Fan-out can starve individual apps; test catches it.

comments.idea: Pair A5-034 (parallel argocd sync --async) with a per-app timeout map so one slow app doesn't mask successes — catches the "1/15 stuck" pattern.
comments.justification: Aggregate "max" hides single-app stuck cases.

comments.idea: A5-034 (`argocd app sync --async` fan-out) replaces the per-app serial sync script in any current bring-up automation.
comments.justification: Trivially parallel.

ideas.idea: Pre-build a self-signed CA + Cognito client config in the sandbox and inject as a TF variable so phase-1 doesn't have to mint these mid-apply.
ideas.justification: Removes a serial AWS-API leg from inside the management apply.

ideas.idea: Add a `terraform apply -auto-approve -compact-warnings -parallelism=30` wrapper script that's the canonical entrypoint, bumping the default 10.
ideas.justification: Cheapest single throughput win; AWS API rate limits, not terraform's default, are the real ceiling.

comments.idea: A5-036 (canonical apply wrapper with -parallelism=30) lets us delete every per-script terraform-flags string and consolidate flag policy in one place.
comments.justification: One wrapper, one policy.

ideas.idea: Maintain a "phase status board" markdown file that subagents append to as they finish, giving a real-time gantt of the bring-up.
ideas.justification: Gives both human and the conductor agent a single pane for "where are we".

comments.idea: Pair A5-037 (status board markdown) with an auto-generated svg gantt embedded so PR reviewers see parallelism, not just text.
comments.justification: Visual evidence of orchestration wins makes them defensible.

comments.idea: A5-037 (live status board) makes the manual handoff "what's the current state" prose section much shorter — board is the source of truth.
comments.justification: Generated > written.

ideas.idea: Use AWS SDK pagination + `aws cloudformation` events-style polling (or `aws ec2 wait`) directly instead of terraform's internal polling.
ideas.justification: Sometimes terraform polls every 30 s; direct waiters poll every 5 s.

ideas.idea: Pre-create the S3 backend bucket + DynamoDB lock table once at account-rotation time and bake their names into the sandbox env, eliminating bootstrap.
ideas.justification: Removes the awkward "chicken-and-egg" backend bootstrap from every fresh account.

comments.idea: A5-039 (pre-baked S3/Dynamo backend) retires the chicken-and-egg `bootstrap-backend.sh` and its README section.
comments.justification: One-time setup, never reinvoked.

ideas.idea: Run a "rehearsal cluster" on kind/k3d locally in parallel with the real EKS bring-up, so Crossplane composition logic is verified without AWS latency.
ideas.justification: Decouples composition-function iteration from EKS-creation wall-clock.

comments.idea: Pair A5-040 (kind rehearsal cluster) with a webhook that auto-promotes a successful kind run to a real-EKS dispatch — closes the loop.
comments.justification: Two-step "rehearse then promote" eliminates the manual gate.

comments.idea: Add an e2e harness on top of A5-040 (kind rehearsal cluster) that runs the entire A2 chaos suite locally before the real-EKS run.
comments.justification: Two-cluster discipline halves real-EKS feedback loop.

comments.idea: A5-040 (rehearsal kind cluster) should snapshot composition function inputs from the rehearsal and diff them against the real EKS run — proves equivalence.
comments.justification: Kind rehearsal is only valuable if proven equivalent to EKS.

ideas.idea: Use `kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts` in a fan-out across all CRDs at once instead of letting ArgoCD reconcile them serially.
ideas.justification: ArgoCD applies in waves; direct fan-out collapses waves into one round trip.

ideas.idea: Have one subagent watch CloudWatch metrics live (AWS API throttling, EKS API latency) and feed back-pressure signals to other subagents.
ideas.justification: Prevents N parallel agents from collectively tripping AWS rate limits.

comments.idea: Pair A5-042 (rate-limit back-pressure) with auto-emitting CloudWatch custom metrics `OrchestratorBackpressureEvents` so throttling is graphable.
comments.justification: Proves the back-pressure actually fires when AWS APIs get hot.

comments.idea: Add a soak test around A5-042 (CloudWatch back-pressure feedback) that runs 20 subagents in parallel for 30 min asserting zero AWS throttle errors.
comments.justification: Back-pressure controller must work under sustained load.

comments.idea: Extend A5-042 (backpressure watcher) with a regression test that throttling above threshold actually causes subagents to slow down — the watcher must demonstrably feed back.
comments.justification: Backpressure systems are notorious for silently not back-pressuring.

ideas.idea: Build a "trigger-on-condition" wrapper: `await k8s/condition:Ready/<resource> && cmd` so chained pipelines read like a Makefile.
ideas.justification: DSL clarity makes complex bring-up sequences reviewable.

comments.idea: Use A5-043 (await-condition DSL) as the canonical wait primitive in every A2 e2e scenario.
comments.justification: Same DSL for ops and tests.

ideas.idea: Cache `helm dependency build` output across sessions in the repo (`charts/.cache/`) so chart deps don't re-resolve every fresh sandbox.
ideas.justification: Saves ~10 s per chart, x5 charts = 50 s per fresh sandbox.

ideas.idea: Use `terraform state pull` once, then operate on a local copy in parallel speculative plans, and only `state push` when confirmed.
ideas.justification: Lets multiple "what-if" plans run without contending on the real state lock.

ideas.idea: Fire phase-2 ArgoCD bootstrap manifest as a `kubernetes_manifest` *inside* the management terraform so it's atomic with the helm release.
ideas.justification: Removes a manual hand-off; bring-up becomes one `terraform apply`.

comments.idea: Add a contract test that A5-046 (atomic helm+bootstrap apply) leaves the cluster in the same final state as the two-step path.
comments.justification: Consolidation must not regress final state.

comments.idea: Pair A5-046 (atomic Application via kubernetes_manifest) with a tear-down test asserting `terraform destroy` cleanly removes the Application without leaving cluster-side orphan.
comments.justification: kubernetes_manifest has historical destroy-time edge cases.

comments.idea: A5-046 (atomic ArgoCD bootstrap inside terraform) lets us delete the separate `bootstrap-argocd.sh` script and its accompanying handoff step.
comments.justification: One apply, one outcome.

ideas.idea: Run `chainsaw` smoke tests against a kind cluster in parallel with the real apply so policy regressions surface in seconds, not minutes.
ideas.justification: Today chainsaw runs only via CI workflow; local-parallel collapses the feedback loop.

ideas.idea: Convert phase 2's "wait 3 min for ArgoCD refresh" into a `argocd app sync --hard-refresh` triggered the instant a manifest commit lands.
ideas.justification: The single biggest documented wait (handoff Step 4) becomes a sub-second push.

comments.idea: Pair A5-048 (hard-refresh on commit) with an emitted "sync latency" metric per Application so the speedup is provable and regression-able.
comments.justification: Without metrics, the win evaporates over time.

comments.idea: A5-013 + A5-048 (kick ArgoCD sync immediately / hard-refresh) lets us delete every `sleep 180` waiting for ArgoCD's 3-min refresh window in scripts and tests.
comments.justification: Event-driven replaces fixed sleeps.

ideas.idea: Introduce a "warm pool" of pre-applied phase-0 VPCs left running between sessions (within sandbox limits) so phase-1 can start without phase-0 wait.
ideas.justification: Saves the entire 5-min phase-0 critical path when iterating on phase-1/2 fixes.

comments.idea: Extend A5-049/050 (warm pool VPCs) with a daily tag-audit job asserting all warm pool resources still carry `lifecycle=warm` — defends against accidental promotion to ephemeral.
comments.justification: Warm pool resources getting GC'd by cleanup scripts is the obvious risk.

comments.idea: Add a teardown e2e that confirms A5-049/A5-050 (warm VPC pool) can be safely imported then destroyed without orphans.
comments.justification: Warm-pool patterns introduce orphan risk; explicit teardown test.

comments.idea: A5-049/A5-050 (warm pool / import existing VPC) need a session-start invariant test that the warm pool VPC matches the expected CIDR and subnet count — drift after import is silent.
comments.justification: Imported state can mismatch source-of-truth; explicit assert is cheap.

comments.idea: A5-049 + A5-050 (warm pool / import) lets us delete the phase-0 step from session bring-up checklists entirely when iterating downstream.
comments.justification: Skip-phase-0 becomes the default fast path.

ideas.idea: Use `terraform import` + `terraform refresh` against a pre-existing warm VPC instead of recreating it, so phase-1 attaches to an extant network.
ideas.justification: Even bigger win than A5-049: zero phase-0 wall-clock at all.

comments.idea: Add a teardown e2e that confirms A5-049/A5-050 (warm VPC pool) can be safely imported then destroyed without orphans.
comments.justification: Warm-pool patterns introduce orphan risk; explicit teardown test.

comments.idea: A5-049/A5-050 (warm pool / import existing VPC) need a session-start invariant test that the warm pool VPC matches the expected CIDR and subnet count — drift after import is silent.
comments.justification: Imported state can mismatch source-of-truth; explicit assert is cheap.

comments.idea: A5-049 + A5-050 (warm pool / import) lets us delete the phase-0 step from session bring-up checklists entirely when iterating downstream.
comments.justification: Skip-phase-0 becomes the default fast path.

general_comments.idea: Add an "orchestration-as-code" lint asserting every parallel-eligible terraform root declares `# parallel-safe-with: [...]` so future refactors can re-derive the DAG.
general_comments.justification: Implicit parallelism becomes self-documenting.

general_comments.idea: Add a `phase-bring-up-replay.sh` that takes a session ID and re-runs the exact dispatch sequence from the orchestrator log — turns sessions into reproducible tapes.
general_comments.justification: Reproducibility is the second-order win of recording orchestration.

general_comments.idea: Add a sandbox-wide AWS API rate dashboard (CloudWatch metric on `ThrottlingException` counts per service) so the rate-limit ceiling is visible, not just guessed.
general_comments.justification: Knowing the actual ceiling enables max-parallelism tuning.

general_comments.idea: Pair parallel root applies with a `runbook-parallel-apply-debug.md` documenting how to attribute a failure to the right root when N applies are in flight.
general_comments.justification: Parallel without traceability is parallel chaos.

general_comments.idea: Add a `subagent-pool-status.md` auto-updated dashboard so the conductor's view is also the operator's view.
general_comments.justification: Avoids the "what is the conductor thinking" debug class.

general_comments.idea: Pair the EKS watcher with a `notify-when-condition.sh` generic helper used everywhere — one tool, many uses.
general_comments.justification: Generic primitives outlive bespoke watchers.

general_comments.idea: Cache the speculative-plan JSON to a known path so the next agent can read it without re-running.
general_comments.justification: Shaves another 20s every time.

general_comments.idea: Pair `argocd app sync` with `runbook-argocd-sync-failure.md` enumerating the five blockers (RBAC, sync-wave, CRD missing, hook fail, prune-conflict).
general_comments.justification: Sync errors are often opaque; runbook decodes them.

general_comments.idea: Have the background `kubectl wait` emit a `/tmp/wait-events.log` line per resource transition so a debugger can replay.
general_comments.justification: Wait-in-background loses observability without a log.

general_comments.idea: Add a `wait-then-trigger.sh --on-fail` mode that runs a diagnose helper instead of just exiting — auto-debug on first failure.
general_comments.justification: "Wait then trigger" is good; "wait then debug if fail" is better.

general_comments.idea: Make the event bus topology + topic list a one-page `event-bus-topics.md` runbook so subagents know what to subscribe to.
general_comments.justification: Buses without topic registries become noise.

general_comments.idea: Pair tmux panes with a `tmux-layout-phase-N.sh` script per phase that auto-arranges the panes for that phase's likely debug session.
general_comments.justification: One command vs five tmux invocations.

general_comments.idea: Pipe `crossplane beta trace` stream output into the dispatch-history doc, so the trace becomes part of the session record.
general_comments.justification: Ephemeral traces are forgotten; persistent ones become evidence.

general_comments.idea: Add a `argocd-app-sync-all-and-quote.sh` wrapper that emits a markdown-ready table of post-sync conditions, satisfying verify-evidence requirement.
general_comments.justification: Sync without evidence-quote is the silent-pass class.

general_comments.idea: Have the status board auto-generate a final `session-gantt.svg` at session end for the handoff — visualizes wall-clock waste.
general_comments.justification: Visual artifact drives next-session optimization.

general_comments.idea: Pair the back-pressure subagent with a `runbook-aws-throttle.md` listing the per-service throttle codes and recommended backoff multipliers.
general_comments.justification: Throttle detection without remediation is just complaining.

general_comments.idea: After local-kind chainsaw, auto-diff results vs the last real-cluster run — surfaces simulation drift early.
general_comments.justification: Local-rehearsal is only useful if its accuracy is tracked.

general_comments.idea: Pair warm-pool VPCs with `warm-pool-status.sh` that asserts the warm VPC still matches sandbox quota and isn't itself the cap-killer.
general_comments.justification: Warm pool can become orphan-leak; needs its own guardrail.

general_comments.idea: A `scripts/orchestrate/phase-graph.json` that declares phase × component DAG; a `phase-up.py` reads it and runs everything that can run in parallel at each frontier, with a Gantt-style progress dashboard.
general_comments.justification: Codifies parallelism so future agents don't have to rediscover it.

general_comments.idea: A "warm pool" subagent that, while phase-1 EKS is creating (15 min), pre-pulls every Helm chart, pre-renders every manifest, pre-validates every IAM policy doc, and pre-warms ECR images — net zero wall-clock cost.
general_comments.justification: Captures the explicit "parallel unrelated work" insight from the user's prompt.

general_comments.idea: Use the existing two-AZ constraint to deliberately structure modules so AZ-A and AZ-B resources can be applied as two parallel `terraform apply -target=` invocations.
general_comments.justification: Same wall-clock budget gets twice the work done; safe within sandbox caps.

general_comments.idea: A "bring-up race report" that records, per phase, which step was on the critical path; PR description auto-includes it so the next session knows where to attack next.
general_comments.justification: Continuous improvement loop on cold-start time.

general_comments.idea: Run the brainstorming-style fan-out pattern itself (this very session) as a reusable harness: `scripts/orchestrate/fanout.py <brief> <N>` spawns N subagents on a shared workspace.
general_comments.justification: Generalizes what worked here so future brainstorms / reviews / audits are one command.
